name: Bafang Yunji International Company Limited
summary: Bafang Yunji International Company Limited, together with its subsidiaries, operates and franchises restaurants in Taiwan, Hong Kong, and the United States. The company manufactures and sells processed bean products; and baked and steamed food products. It also engages in the wholesale of food and groceries; and retail of beverages. In addition, the company provides pot stickers; boiled dumplings; noodles and wontons with sauces; noodle and dumplings with soup; side dishes; drinks; uncooked dumplings and wontons; and beef meals under BaFang brand. Bafang Yunji International Company Limited was founded in 1990 and is based in New Taipei City, Taiwan.
